operations.title: WP38: the charge is CKM-composite - q_u = H_12.sin(phi) = kappa_u * V_ub exactly per sheet across all 232 u-class sheets (kappa_u = 9.678574167082195; 231/232 within 9.2e-9, one 3.4e-6 outlier; chi2-independent, corr 0.14); t-class q_t constant at 8.4e-9 with CKM tracking unresolvable; c-class genuinely approximate ~1% in all candidate ratios; M (WP36 magnitude factor) is not an edge-magnitude monomial (exponents ~0); kappa_u > y_t^2 so no pure-Yukawa monomial exists, bounded search yields only numerology-grade hits - derivation OPEN; first exact chart-to-readout bridge (chart data tied to physical V_ub) (ledger 1979)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP38 - the u-class charge is exactly kappa*V_ub per sheet; first exact chart-to-readout bridge
operations.body: WP38 (ledger 1979, results/wp38_charge_ckm.json, 5/5 gates) upgrades the WP37 charge law. The u-class 'class constant' q_u=3.621e-2 was a shadow: per sheet, q_u = H_12.sin(phi) = kappa_u * V_ub EXACTLY (kappa_u = 9.678574167082195; 231/232 sheets within 9.2e-9, one 3.4e-6 outlier; deviation chi2-independent so not fit noise). This is chart data (up-block off-diagonal x down-loop phase) locked to a PHYSICAL observable by a pure number - the first exact chart-to-readout bridge in the flavor sector, i.e. a candidate H2LR pairing component. t-class: q_t const at 1e-8, CKM tracking unresolvable. c-class: genuinely approximate ~1%, no hidden exact law. Negative: the WP36 magnitude factor M is not an edge-magnitude monomial (regression exponents ~0, consistent with M ~ Du.Dd); kappa_u > y_t^2 rules out any pure-Yukawa monomial, bounded search gives only numerology - derivation open via the LO expression of V_ub for u-anchor textures. WP11 stands; phi remains chart data.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Strominger: WP38 - exact charge-CKM bridge in the flavor chart ensemble
operations.body: WP38 (ledger 1979, results/wp38_charge_ckm.json): sharpening WP37. The u-class charge q_u = H_12.sin(phi) is exactly kappa_u * V_ub per sheet (kappa_u = 9.678574167082195, bulk precision 9.2e-9 over 232 sheets, one mild outlier, chi2-independent). Chart data thereby locks to a physical CKM observable with a pure-number constant - an exact chart-to-readout bridge. kappa_u exceeds y_t^2, so no pure-Yukawa monomial expresses it; a bounded factor search found no defensible identification (numerology-grade only). Open: derive kappa_u from the texture LO structure of V_ub. All statements remain chart-space theorems; WP11 untouched.
